title: Parse numbers together with their units
environment: Compound area strings in the observed parser. Other unit systems, locale separators and ambiguous input need their own explicit contracts.
goal: Normalize an area string containing metric and alternate-unit values.
approach: Historical failed assumption: The first numeric token plus a unit appearing anywhere in the string was assumed to identify a measurement.
what_worked: Historical correction: Read the numeric token immediately associated with each unit. Convert only when exactly one of the expected units is absent. Verification reported by the source: A recorded diagnostic stored both supplied values correctly; five focused parsing cases passed.
what_failed: Historical observed failure: A string containing both values used the first number as the alternate unit and converted it incorrectly.
why: Confirmed: numeric extraction happened before unit-specific association.
improved_method: Parse number-unit pairs rather than separate number and unit lists. Test both orders, each single unit, separators and malformed input.
when_to_use: Compound area strings in the observed parser. Other unit systems, locale separators and ambiguous input need their own explicit contracts.
when_not_to_use: Do not extrapolate outside the recorded conditions or use partial evidence to claim general product or release acceptance.
known_limitations: This is an independently curated generalization of an earlier recorded failure. No source-side experiment was rerun during this registration; observation_date is the 2026-10-09 knowledge-review date, not the incident date. Applicability and root-cause claims remain limited to the source-reported conditions.
